subject: general
question: To do a certain work, the ratio of efficiency of P, Q and R is 6 ∶ 5 ∶ 4. Working together, they can complete the work in 20 days. They work together for 10 days. 50% of the remaining work will be completed by Q alone in∶
solution:
Efficiency ratio of P, Q and R = 6 ∶ 5 ∶ 4

Total work = (6 + 5 + 4) × 20 = 15 × 20 = 300

Work completed by three in 10 days = 15 × 10 = 150

Remaining work = 300 – 150 = 150

50% of the remaining work = 150 × (1/2) = 75

50% of the remaining work will complete Q alone in = 75/5 = 15 days
